technical_and_design_decisions: Treat the increment as an enhancement to the existing Spring XD-era codebase rather than a migration to Spring Framework 6 or Java 17, because the requested dependency versions target the older Spring Boot 1.2.x generation.

Implement alternative DLQ behavior as a configurable error-channel or message-handler destination that preserves the original message and adds exception metadata, including the exception message and stack trace, as headers.

Implement the database event-stream module as a generic relational-database change poller with configurable tables, keys, polling interval, and durable checkpoints; use an existing Spring Integration/JDBC abstraction rather than implementing vendor-specific transaction-log readers.
Expose RabbitMQ cluster connectivity through configurable broker addresses and connection-factory settings, using the native Spring AMQP connection-factory capabilities where possible.
Upgrade GemFire and Spring Data dependencies together, preserving existing cache and repository APIs and isolating compatibility changes behind the existing Spring XD integration layer.

Support colocated stream modules through the existing container deployment model, with a single active stream leader and failover coordination through the platform's existing distributed coordination service.

Use the specified Spring Integration, Spring Integration Kafka, Spring Boot, and dependency versions as the target baseline, applying compatibility changes only where compilation or runtime behavior requires them.
Perform automated unit, integration, upgrade-compatibility, and end-to-end regression testing as part of the implementation rather than treating testing as a separate post-release phase.
assumptions: The existing build, container runtime, metadata store, distributed coordination service, and test infrastructure are available and operational.
The developer has access to the required milestone, GA, Spring Data Gosling, GemFire, Spring Integration, and Kafka artifacts when implementation begins.

The database change-stream module initially supports common relational databases through polling and checkpointing; vendor-specific log-based CDC, schema-history management, and exactly-once delivery are out of scope.
Database event delivery is at-least-once, with durable offsets and documented duplicate-handling semantics.
RabbitMQ HA/FT support requires connection to a configured list of broker nodes and does not include implementation of a new RabbitMQ clustering protocol.
Leader election uses the existing coordination mechanism and does not require creation of a new consensus service.
The same-container deployment feature applies to stream modules managed by the existing Spring XD container and does not include a redesign of the deployment scheduler or security model.
Dependency upgrades will be validated against the existing supported operating systems and Java runtime; unrelated modernization or API redesign is excluded.
Documentation covers configuration, operational behavior, examples, and upgrade notes, but not a complete rewrite of all framework documentation.

Effort is for one developer and includes coding, test development, local integration testing, and release preparation; it excludes elapsed waiting time for external releases and infrastructure provisioning.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the existing module, container, messaging, dependency-management, and test architectures; refine interfaces, configuration properties, compatibility constraints, and implementation plans for all eight user stories.

Add configuration for an alternate dead-letter destination, route failed messages appropriately, attach exception and stack-trace headers, preserve existing DLQ behavior by default, and add unit and integration tests.

Design and implement the out-of-the-box database source module, including configurable change detection, checkpoint persistence, event mapping, restart recovery, destination-independent event output, error handling, and representative relational-database integration tests.

Add broker-cluster connection configuration, connection-factory integration, failover/reconnect behavior, validation of queue declaration and consumption across nodes, and tests for single-node and multi-node configurations.

activities.activity_name: GemFire and Spring Data compatibility upgrade
activities.activity_description: Upgrade GemFire and related Spring Data dependencies, resolve API and behavioral incompatibilities, update configuration and serialization integration, and run cache and repository compatibility tests.

activities.activity_name: Colocated stream deployment and leader failover
activities.activity_description: Enable stream modules to run in the same container, define lifecycle and resource-isolation behavior, implement leader election and standby activation using the existing coordination service, handle ownership loss and recovery, and add failover integration tests.

activities.activity_name: Spring Integration milestone or GA upgrade
activities.activity_description: Upgrade Spring Integration to the requested milestone or GA baseline, synchronize related modules, adapt changed APIs and JMX behavior, and execute messaging, management, and application-context regression tests.
Upgrade the Spring Integration Kafka dependency, adapt producer and consumer configuration to changed APIs, verify offset and error behavior, and run Kafka integration and regression tests.

activities.activity_name: Spring Boot 1.2.3 and transitive dependency alignment
activities.activity_description: Upgrade Spring Boot and the listed dependency versions, regenerate or update dependency management, resolve compilation and runtime conflicts, check supported adapters, and validate representative application startup and packaging scenarios.

Run the complete build and test suite, add missing cross-feature tests, validate upgrade interactions among messaging, container, database, GemFire, Kafka, and Boot components, and diagnose and fix integration defects.

Document configuration properties, DLQ headers, database source setup and checkpointing, RabbitMQ cluster configuration, colocated deployment and failover behavior, dependency upgrade notes, and representative usage examples.

activities.activity_name: Build, packaging, CI, and release preparation
activities.activity_description: Update build metadata and CI jobs, verify reproducible packaging and distribution artifacts, perform clean-install and upgrade checks, prepare release notes, and complete final quality checks.
